summary.text: Haseeb Fatmi is a Democratic state senator from North Carolina who represents District 18 and is seeking election to the seat in the November 3, 2026 general election against Republican Chris Stock and Libertarian Brad Hessel.
An attorney, he was appointed to the Senate in May 2026 after serving on the Wake Forest Town Commission.

paragraphs.text: Fatmi graduated from Enloe Magnet High School, earned a bachelor's degree from the University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill in 2009 and received a law degree from Fordham University Law in 2012, according to Ballotpedia.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in North Carolina, is an attorney and has worked as an adjunct professor for over a decade.
Fatmi served on the Wake Forest Town Commission before entering the Senate.
Gov. Josh Stein appointed him on May 15, 2026, to the District 18 seat vacated by Terence Everitt, and he assumed office on May 21, 2026.

The General Assembly's website lists his district as covering parts of Granville and Wake counties and shows committee assignments in Appropriations on General Government and Information Technology, Judiciary, Pensions and Retirement and Aging, and Regulatory Reform.
In the Ballotpedia survey, Fatmi said his priorities include lowering energy costs, strengthening public schools, increasing access to affordable healthcare and investing in local communities.
